Resonance Core

The centre of a Resonance Array, which makes rare materials with ancient craft.

  • Layout: up to eight Resonance Pedestals 3 blocks from the core (four sides and four corners). Put the catalyst on the core, the materials on the pedestals, and give the core a soul signal (128 SP at strength 15).
  • Recipes:
  • Amethyst shard + 4 sculk + 4 soul essence → 2 echo shards
  • Amethyst cluster + 4 soul essence → 4 charoite
  • Deepslate + 4 bone blocks + 4 soul crystal blocks → reinforced deepslate
  • Resonant disc + 4 amethyst shards + 2 soul essence + 2 note blocks → 2 copies of the disc (to copy ritual discs)
  • A working core makes grinders and sifters within 8 blocks run 50 % faster; on a kinetic network it runs 1.5× faster.

KindBlock
ToolAny / no tool needed

Soul Conduit

A living vein of red sculk that carries the engine's song where you need it.

  • Connects in all six directions, so it runs up walls, across gaps and through the air. It glows red while souls flow through it.
  • The signal drops one level every 2 blocks, so it reaches about 30 blocks from the engine; use Soul Repeaters to go further.
  • Redstone parts see it as a power source: lamps light, pistons push, repeaters and comparators read it.
  • It also carries vanilla signals: a lever, repeater, comparator, redstone torch or block of redstone touching it sends its signal along, but that signal has no soul: the conduit turns the dead blue of Overworld sculk and machines do not run. Redstone dust cannot feed a conduit.
  • Hiding it: use any full block on it to wrap the conduit in that block's look; it still carries the signal and stops glowing. Use an empty hand to take the block off.
  • Next to vanilla parts it grows a fitting joint: a collar for lamps, pistons and hoppers; it bends to the floor for redstone dust, rails and repeaters; a thin tendril reaches levers, buttons and torches.
  • Special sources: a Singer within 3 blocks sings into it (strength 15, 64 SP, about two and a half minutes, then half a minute of rest); a sculk catalyst touching it sends a 10 s signal (32 SP) when something dies nearby; a sculk shrieker touching it screams when the circuit overloads.

building_sets:
Building families

Every Sift stone has a full building set: the stone, bricks and chiseled bricks, each with slabs, stairs and walls. Void stone, void obsidian, soulshale and varied dark slate also have polished, cracked, tile and smooth forms.

  • Bricks: 4 stone (2×2) → 4 bricks.
  • Chiseled bricks: 2 brick slabs stacked.
  • Polished: 4 stone → 4 polished; tiles: 4 bricks → 4 tiles.
  • Smooth: smelt the stone; cracked: smelt the bricks.
  • Pillar: 2 stone stacked → 2 pillars.
  • Stonecutter: every form cuts into slabs, stairs and walls.
  • Soulshale: 8 abyssal strata around 1 soul sand or soul soil → 8.

Harmonizer

Guardian of the Willow Grove, a giant jellyfish. One of the three guardians in the codex.

Combat

  • Keeps 11–17 blocks from its target.
  • Sonic cone: 60° fan, 8 damage, ignores armor.
  • Resonance ring: expands from 2 to 7 blocks, 6 damage; jump over it or stay inside it.
  • Slams for 10 when you get close.
  • Roar: calls 5 monsters and beams Strength and Resistance onto them.
  • Tentacle grab for 7; a purple vortex pulls you in and slams you for 16 (keep jumping to break free).
  • On death it sends nearby monsters berserk; in phase 2 it calls 3 fuseflies.

Arena

Resonant Spirit Lake Pavilion: a 3-deep ring of spirit liquid, concentric stone rings, 4 bridges, 16 organ-pipe pillars and curtains of willow leaves.

Boss Shared rules

All three bosses follow these rules:

  • Below 50 % health they enter phase 2: +30 % attack, +15 % speed, skill cooldowns × 0.65, and they call reinforcements.
  • With no target they heal 2 % of their health per second, and walk back if they get more than 20 blocks from the arena centre.
  • Each kill drops: 1 core, 2–4 shards, 3–6 soul essence, 2–4 siftite ingots, and a 25 % chance of the soulite upgrade template.
  • Rematch: place a Sift Altar within 48 blocks of the arena and use a Summoning Sigil on it.

page/story:
Story

The setting: the Overworld infected the Sift

Most people think sculk grew out of the Deep Dark and slowly spread through the world. It is the other way round: the Overworld infected the Sift.

The Sift is a sieve between souls, a bright and living world. The glowing spirit liquid that runs through it is its blood, and the Sift's creatures live on it.

  • Sculk belongs to the Sift. Healthy sculk is red (red sculk). The blue sculk of the Deep Dark is the same sculk, starving and rotting.
  • The Overworld's air has no souls in it. A Sift creature that leaves the spirit liquid starves and goes hollow, the way a piglin turns into a zombified piglin in the Overworld.

The out-of-tune ritual of the Ancient City

The people of the Ancient City tried to open a door to the Sift by singing. They set eight resonant jukeboxes in front of the frame, to play eight notes in order.

  • The right order is 1 3 7 6 5 2 4 8.
  • They played 1 3 4 6 5 2 4 8: the third disc was wrong.

The door tore open. Red sculk and one Singer were swept into the Overworld, and the ancients died in front of the door.

  • Reinforced deepslate cannot be mined because the ancients' bones are built into the frame.
  • The Singer trapped in the Overworld slowly went hollow and became the Mourner. It still sits there, singing the melody backwards, trying to close the door.
  • Wardens are hollowed Sift creatures too, kin to the Singers. They live only on the souls they swallowed, and they rage at sound because sound opens the door.

Rifts and rot

The failed opening left cracks across the world: wild rifts. Soulless Overworld air leaks back into the Sift through them and rots the red sculk blue. That is the real infection.

The deepest knot of that rot is the final boss, the Sculk Monstrosity.

How the story moves

The story is driven by things you do in the game. Each act grants a story advancement and unlocks pages in the codex.

ActWhat happensHow it is triggered
PrologueFind the codex and the ancient pagesYou get the Sift Codex the first time you enter the Sift; pages I–IV are in Ancient City chests
The Octave RitualOpen the door again with the right songSee The Octave Ritual

KinA Singer calms a WardenA Singer that sees a Warden within 24 blocks trembles, then sings the octave backwards; the Warden stays calm for 30 s ("Lullaby for the Deep")
HollowingA Singer becomes a Mourner in the OverworldA Singer with no soul crystal block or spirit liquid within 6 blocks goes hollow after about 5 minutes; 10 s in spirit liquid brings it back ("Homeward Song")
Bring It HomeCure a WardenA Warden that soaks in spirit liquid for 15 s, or spends 30 s in the Sift, becomes a Sift Warden ("Bring It Home")
The Rot RecedesDefeat the Sculk MonstrosityOnce it dies the rot stops everywhere and blue sculk slowly turns red again ("The Rot Recedes")
Stitched ShutClose a riftUse a Rift Seal on a portal; rot within 12 blocks starts to heal ("Stitched Shut")
Finale: They Went HomeSend the Singer and the Warden homeAfter the Monstrosity is dead, bring a Singer and a Sift Warden to the Ancient City frame and blow the Mourning Horn. The Singer sings the right octave, both walk through the door and the city's sculk turns red; they show up in the Sift later

page/guide:
Getting started

This page follows the order you play in. Every step links to the full numbers.

1. Getting ready

  1. Find an Ancient City: in the middle of the Deep Dark's Ancient City stands a reinforced-deepslate frame. City chests hold ancient pages I–IV.
  2. Collect eight discs: Pigstep, Relic, Precipice, Creator, 5, Otherside, 13 and Tears. See The Octave Ritual for where each comes from.
  3. Bring a goat horn and echo shards: the horn calls a Singer, and an echo shard asks it to start the ritual.
  4. Plan for antidotes: spirit liquid is everywhere in the Sift and touching it causes soul deprivation. The Soul Antidote (glass bottle, gloomcap, soul berries, echo shard) needs Sift ingredients, so on your first trip just stay out of the liquid.

2. First visit

  • You get the Sift Codex on arrival. It fills in as you meet creatures and find pages.
  • To go home, hold a Homeward Stone for 3 seconds, or build a closed frame of soul crystal blocks and use an echo shard on it.
  • The Sift has no day or night, only dusk. Beds do not work; use a respawn anchor.

3. First materials

MaterialWhereUsed for
Siftite oreEvery biome, Y −40 to 40Smelts into siftite ingots: siftite tools and armor, the altar, gears
Charoite clustersViolet Slate Abyss surface and cavesCharoite: the beacon, sigils, soulite
Aurum oreLullaby Hills riverbedsAurum tools (fast, easy to enchant), aurum apples
Patina oreSoul Caldera rift wallsSoul Power pipes and conduits
Gloomcap, soul berriesCave floors; next to spirit liquid pondsAntidotes, Soul Ward potions, stews

A full siftite set softens the spirit liquid drain from 20 % of your health to 50 %. Make it first.

4. The three guardians

Each boss lives in an arena in its own biome. A Soul Compass points to the arenas (sneak + use to switch), or use /locate boss.

BossBiomeCoreShard
HarmonizerWillow GroveHarmonizer CoreResonant Crystal
MonarchAmber DunesMonarch CrownMonarch Feather Blade
Sculk MonstrosityViolet Slate AbyssSculk Monstrosity HeartSculk Scale

Each kill drops one core, but the weapons and the beacon gem both need cores, so you fight each boss at least twice. To fight again, place a Sift Altar within 48 blocks of the arena and use a Summoning Sigil on it.

5. Boss weapons and awakening

WeaponMade fromWhat it does
Sonic StaffHarmonizer core, resonant crystal, siftite ingotCharge 0.6 s for a sonic blast: 8 damage, 15 blocks, chains to 3 enemies
Dash CharmMonarch crown, monarch feather, siftite ingotUp to 2 dashes in a row, leaving a decoy for 10 s
Sculk HammerSculk Monstrosity heart, sculk scale, siftite ingotCharged slam that grows exploding sculk maws; falling attack like the mace

At a smithing table, another boss's shard awakens a weapon: the staff hits for 12 with a 2 s cooldown and chains to 5; the charm dashes 3 times and hurts enemies on the way; the hammer's radius grows.

6. The Sift Beacon

Sift Beacon Gem: 6 charoite and the three cores. Inlay it into any chestplate at a smithing table; the wearer and every player within 8 blocks are immune to soul deprivation, and existing deprivation is cleansed.

7. Soulite gear

  • Soulite ingot: netherite ingot, resonant crystal, monarch feather, sculk scale and 4 charoite.
  • Soulite Upgrade Template: 25 % boss drop, also found in chests; duplicate it with charoite.
  • At a smithing table: template, netherite gear and a soulite ingot.

Soulite (durability 2600, armor 4/9/7/4, toughness 4) gives every piece its own power, and the full set is immune to soul deprivation. See the Soulite Sword page.

8. The ending

Beat the Sculk Monstrosity and the rot stops. Stitch the rifts with Rift Seals, then take a Singer and a Sift Warden back to the Ancient City and blow the Mourning Horn for the finale.
page/portal:
The Octave Ritual and Portals

Opening the door to the Sift

  1. Stand within 16 blocks of the Ancient City's reinforced-deepslate frame and blow a goat horn. If no other Singer is within 24 blocks, a ritual Singer appears.
  2. Use an echo shard on the Singer. Two Echo Golems set 8 resonant jukeboxes in front of the frame.
  3. Each jukebox shines a coloured beam. Insert the matching disc left to right in rainbow order:
SeatDiscBeamWhere to find it
1PigstepRedBastion remnants
2RelicOrangeTrail ruins (suspicious gravel)
3PrecipiceYellowTrial chambers
4CreatorGreenOminous vaults
55BlueAncient cities (disc fragments)
6OthersideIndigoStrongholds, ancient cities
713VioletDungeons
8TearsPinkKilling a ghast
  • All correct: the frame fills with a portal. Stand in it for 2 seconds to travel.
  • Any wrong disc: the door tears, dark sculk bursts out and all discs pop out. Just insert them again.
  • The jukeboxes are the key: break any one and the door closes.

Getting home

  • In the Sift, build a closed frame of soul crystal blocks and use an echo shard on it to make a portal home.
  • Or hold a Homeward Stone for 3 seconds.

Wild rifts

About one in 600 chunks of the Sift has a wild rift: a small door back to the Overworld ringed with blue-and-red rot. Rifts never appear in the underground layers.
page/soul:
Soul Deprivation and Spirit Liquid

Spirit liquid

Spirit liquid is the Sift's blood. It flows like water, glows (light 10) and fits in a bucket.

WhenResult
A player touches itSoul deprivation (below)
Another mob touches it3 s of soul deprivation

Soul deprivation

  • Triggered by touching spirit liquid; lasts 20 seconds.
  • Your health is drained to 20 % (at least 1 point).
  • Soul shatter: take any damage while deprived and the drained 80 % breaks; your maximum health stays locked at 20 % until you drink an antidote or die.
  • While deprived, food does not heal you, and water or rain will not put out the soul flames.
  • Your view turns sculk-like, soul flames rise from your body and your hearts become soul-fire hearts.
  • On mobs: +30 % damage taken and about 1.25 health lost per second.

page/rot:
Rot and Sealing

The rot spreads

Soulless Overworld air flows into the Sift through portals and rifts. Red sculk within 10 blocks of a portal slowly rots into vanilla blue sculk.

Stopping the rot

  • Defeat the Sculk Monstrosity: the world records that the rot has stopped, and blue sculk everywhere slowly turns red again.
  • Rift Seal: use it on a portal to close it; rot within 12 blocks starts to heal.
  • Soul Sifter: a Soul Power machine that turns blue sculk within 8 blocks red.
  • Sift Warden: blue sculk it walks over turns red.
page/soul_power:
Soul Power

The Sift's redstone. In the Sift, a signal is a song; vanilla redstone is "a signal with no soul".

Signal

  • Strength 0–15: 15 next to a Spirit Engine, dropping by 1 every 2 blocks.
  • SP (soul pressure): every running engine adds 256 SP of capacity. Machine speed = 32 × strength ÷ 15.
  • Overload: when use exceeds capacity the signal drops to 0, and after 5 s every creature within 6 blocks gets soul deprivation.
  • A Soul Conduit accepts levers, repeaters, comparators, redstone torches and powered blocks, but not redstone dust. A vanilla signal pauses machines and switches engines off.
  • Use any block on a conduit to hide the conduit inside that block.
  • Wireless signal only goes through charoite beams.

Special sources

  • Singers: a Singer within 3 blocks of a conduit sings into it (strength 15, 64 SP), then rests for 30 s.
  • Sculk catalysts: a blooming catalyst acts as a source for 10 s (32 SP).

Parts

BlockWhat it does
Spirit EnginePower source; needs spirit liquid
Spirit PumpPumps spirit liquid, 4000 mB tank; one bucket every 2 s at 32 RPM
Spirit PipeCarries spirit liquid to the engine; a pipe connected at one end only leaks and turns dirt or sand into soul soil
Soul ConduitCarries the signal
Soul RepeaterRepeats (16 SP)
Soul FilterChooses which signal passes
Soul GaugeShows soul pressure
Soul Note BlockPlays eight notes; the door song is 1 3 7 6 5 2 4 8
Soul GrinderGrinding (64 SP at strength 15): bone → 6 bone meal, siftite ore → 2 raw siftite, doubled ores, cobblestone → gravel → sand
Soul SifterSifting (96 SP at strength 15), turns blue sculk within 8 blocks red; blue sculk → red sculk, gravel → flint, sand → clay balls
Charoite Beam Emitter, Charoite Beam Receiver, Charoite PrismWireless beams; use a prism to turn it
Resonance Core, Resonance PedestalResonance Array (128 SP at strength 15): a core and 8 pedestals that make echo shards, charoite and reinforced deepslate, and copy discs

Kinetic add-on

Registered only when config/pysift.properties sets kinetic_addon=on (the default, auto, leaves it off). A Create-style rotation system:

  • Signed RPM and gear ratios; the engine turns at 32 RPM, the hand crank at 32 RPM × 3 SP.
  • Conflicting directions or more than 256 RPM jam the network.
  • Soul Shaft, Soul Cogwheel, Large Soul Cogwheel, Soul Gearbox, Soul Clutch, Soul Gearshift: transmission.
  • Soul Fan: pushes items; blowing through soul fire it "haunts" them (sand → soul sand, dirt → soul soil, torch → soul torch, sculk vein → red sculk vein).
  • Soul Drill: breaks the block in front (hardness × 30 ticks).
  • A Resonance Array on a kinetic network runs 1.5× faster.

page/climate:
Climate variants

Twelve creatures grow up normal, tropical or cold depending on the temperature where they first appear, each with its own model and texture: Nuzzle, Lootkin, Slabber, Prickle, Dartback, Fusefly, Wobble, Nester, Pollinator, Seedling, Sprout, Sentinel.

VariantSift temperatureOther dimensionsLook
Tropical≥ 1.4≥ 0.95Less fur, 3D flowers on the body, brighter colours
Normal0.7–1.40.3–0.95The original look
Cold≤ 0.7≤ 0.3More fur (ruffs, cuffs, tufts), cooler colours
  • Decided the first time the creature appears and never changes; babies take after one parent at random.
  • Tropical biomes: Amber Dunes, Crimson Strata Canyon, Soul Caldera, Spirit Deeps.
  • Cold biomes: Violet Slate Abyss, Withered Hollows.

page/boss_common:
Boss rules

All three bosses follow these rules:

  • Below 50 % health they enter phase 2: +30 % attack, +15 % speed, skill cooldowns × 0.65, and they call reinforcements.
  • With no target they heal 2 % of their health per second, and walk back if they get more than 20 blocks from the arena centre.
  • Each kill drops: 1 core, 2–4 shards, 3–6 soul essence, 2–4 siftite ingots, and a 25 % chance of the soulite upgrade template.
  • Rematch: place a Sift Altar within 48 blocks of the arena and use a Summoning Sigil on it.

home:
The Sift

A Fabric dimension mod for Minecraft 26.3. Step through the out-of-tune door of the Ancient City into a world held at a mint-coloured dusk: glowing rivers of spirit liquid, red sculk, creatures that sing, and three guardians.

This wiki is generated straight from the mod's data, so the numbers, recipes, drops and spawn tables match the game. It covers 643 items and blocks (490 of them blocks), 28 mobs, 10 biomes and 987 recipes.

Start here

  • Story: why the Overworld's sculk is blue, and what the people of the Ancient City got wrong.
  • Getting started: the whole path from opening the portal to beating the three guardians and wearing soulite.
  • The Octave Ritual: how to get into the Sift and where the eight discs come from.
  • Soul Deprivation: the Sift's main danger and how to protect yourself.
